The Tickler passes off counterfeit bills in an attempt to lure the Monster Squad into a trap.

description:

The Ringmaster holds children hostage as part of a larger scheme to buy out and close down all the toy stores in America.

description:

Frank and Dracula sign up for music lessons in an attempt to foil the mad musicians who robbed a telethon.

description:

Mayor Goldwyn gives the city deed to Chief Running Nose.

title: Monster Squad
description:

The Astrologer announces that an earthquake is about to devastate the land, and to make his prediction true, he plans to detonate an atomic bomb.

title: Monster Squad
description:

Ultra Witch dries up the world's milk supply, but she exposes herself by sending a henchman out for cookies.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E09 — The Wizard
The Wizard plans to steal all of the national monuments for his own exhibit.

title: Monster Squad
description:

The Skull decides to resurrect all of the world's villains, beginning with a mummy.

title: Monster Squad
description:

The Weatherman causes a national blizzard in the middle of summer and demands that U.S. citizens unanimously elect him president.

title: Monster Squad
description:

Frank and Bruce are captured by a sheik who's been stealing plumbing supplies just for the thrill of it.

title: Monster Squad
description:

Albert/Alberta begins to flood the world, he/she attempts to gather a collection of animals, which is missing a werewolf and a vampire.
